readings: Using only `player_award_vote`, join each vote record to `player` on `player_id` and discard unmatched records. Exclude players whose `death_country` is NULL or blank. For each death country, show the country, the average non-NULL `points_won`, and the absolute difference between that average and the unweighted average of all displayed countries’ averages, including its own. Do not round.

Using only `manager_award_vote`, join each vote record to `player` on `player_id` and discard unmatched records. Exclude players whose `death_country` is NULL or blank. For each death country, show the country, the average non-NULL `points_won`, and the absolute difference between that average and the unweighted average of all displayed countries’ averages, including its own. Do not round.

Using vote records from both `player_award_vote` and `manager_award_vote`, join each record to `player` on `player_id` and discard unmatched records. Exclude players whose `death_country` is NULL or blank. For each death country, show the country, the average non-NULL `points_won` across both tables, and the absolute difference between that average and the unweighted average of all displayed countries’ averages, including its own. Do not round.
queries:
WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.death_country,
        AVG(v.points_won) AS average_points_won
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    INNER JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE TRIM(p.death_country) <> ''
      AND v.points_won IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT
    death_country,
    average_points_won,
    ABS(average_points_won - AVG(average_points_won) OVER ()) AS absolute_difference
FROM country_averages

WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.death_country AS country,
        AVG(v.points_won) AS average_points_won
    FROM manager_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> ''
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT
    country,
    average_points_won,
    ABS(average_points_won - (SELECT AVG(average_points_won) FROM country_averages)) AS absolute_difference
FROM country_averages

WITH votes AS (
    SELECT player_id, points_won FROM player_award_vote
    UNION ALL
    SELECT player_id, points_won FROM manager_award_vote
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT p.death_country AS country,
           AVG(v.points_won) AS average_points_won
    FROM votes AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> ''
      AND v.points_won IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT country,
       average_points_won,
       ABS(average_points_won - (SELECT AVG(average_points_won) FROM country_averages)) AS absolute_difference
FROM country_averages
